content.en: The **Index of Industrial Production (IIP)** is an index that tracks the growth rates in different industry groups of the economy in a fixed period of time. It is compiled and published monthly by the **National Statistical Office (NSO)**, Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation. The index serves as a barometer for the industrial performance of the Indian economy.
content.hi: The **Index of Industrial Production (IIP)** is an index that tracks the growth rates in different industry groups of the economy in a fixed period of time. It is compiled and published monthly by the **National Statistical Office (NSO)**, Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation. The index serves as a barometer for the industrial performance of the Indian economy.

definition.en: The current base year for IIP is 2011–12, which serves as the reference point for calculating growth.
definition.hi: The current base year for IIP is 2011–12, which serves as the reference point for calculating growth.

definition.en: Eight core industries (Coal, Crude Oil, Natural Gas, Refinery Products, Fertilizers, Steel, Cement, and Electricity) constitute 40.27% of the weight of items included in the IIP.
definition.hi: Eight core industries (Coal, Crude Oil, Natural Gas, Refinery Products, Fertilizers, Steel, Cement, and Electricity) constitute 40.27% of the weight of items included in the IIP.

content.en: IIP also classifies goods into Primary goods, Capital goods, Intermediate goods, Infrastructure/Construction goods, Consumer durables, and Consumer non-durables.
content.hi: IIP also classifies goods into Primary goods, Capital goods, Intermediate goods, Infrastructure/Construction goods, Consumer durables, and Consumer non-durables.

content.en: Students often confuse IIP with GDP growth; remember that IIP is a volume-based index, not a value-based one.
content.hi: Students often confuse IIP with GDP growth; remember that IIP is a volume-based index, not a value-based one.

content.en: Focus on the weightage of the eight core industries as they are a leading indicator for the overall IIP.
content.hi: Focus on the weightage of the eight core industries as they are a leading indicator for the overall IIP.

keyTakeaways.en: IIP is released by the NSO.
keyTakeaways.hi: IIP is released by the NSO.

keyTakeaways.en: Manufacturing has the highest weightage in the index.
